text: Could you make a cheerful picnic flyer with little illustrated flowers? I'm helping get the word out about the picnic, and I'm excited to have something to share. The wording needs to be exactly 'Community Picnic', '12 June 2027', '12:00–15:00', and 'Maple Park, East Gate', and the flyer should be portrait 4:5. I tend to overthink these things, so I'm happy to leave the visual decisions to you. Please don't include any extra text. You can pick the colours yourself.
